# VirtualDesktop (vendored)

This directory contains the MIT-licensed `VirtualDesktop` PowerShell module by
Markus Scholtes, vendored so the Workspace picker works without a separate
PowerShell Gallery installation.

- Upstream: https://github.com/MScholtes/PSVirtualDesktop
- Version: 1.5.11
- License: MIT, see `LICENSE`

The files are kept unmodified. To update, replace the whole directory from the
upstream module release and verify the module catalog and license still match.
